body: Utkarsh SFB, Sep-2026: net worth Rs 2,676 cr but CET1 Rs 1,907 cr after deducting DTA (Rs 495 cr, recognised on an 'independent expert's opinion' after a Rs 1,507 cr pre-tax loss) and intangibles (Rs 53 -> 246 cr when a new core banking system was capitalised). Tier-1 fell 235 bp in one quarter on a Rs 69 cr fall in net worth; nobody asked on the call. Rule: for any lender with recent losses read Pillar 3 DF-11 (rows 9-10), compute P/CET1-book beside P/B, and treat DTA recognised on losses as an option on future profits (CET1 already excludes it). Also: when the deck shows Tier-1 moving more than net worth / RWA explains, find the deduction.
title: For a loss-making lender, value on CET1 book, not reported book: DTA and capitalised software can be a third of net worth and move capital ratios without a loss
